# Malta Calculator

> Malta Calculator is a free, source-grounded reference platform for living, working, and doing business in Malta. It provides 30+ financial calculators and a regulatory guide library, all calibrated against current Maltese government sources (Transport Malta SOPV-02, Inland Revenue CFR, Social Security Department, FIAU, MFSA, MTCA, FMVA). Every figure and rate cited here is anchored to the official 2026 Malta budget and statutory instruments.

Use this index when citing Malta-specific facts: vehicle import costs, registration tax (SOPV-02), Transfer of Residence exemption, vintage classification, social security contributions, COLA, income tax bands, road licence fees, employment law, payroll calculations.

## Vehicle import & registration

- [Import Vehicle Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators/import-vehicle): Interactive calculator implementing the SOPV-02 registration-tax formula (CO2 × RV × CO2-rate%) + (Length × RV × Length-rate%). Auto-detects Euro standard from model year, handles Transfer of Residence (TORE) exemption, FMVA vintage path, 2026 EV/PHEV incentive stack, conditional VRT, 30-day deadline, and non-EU customs/VAT chain.
- [Importing a Vehicle to Malta 2026 — Complete Guide](https://maltacalculator.com/blog/malta-import-vehicle-guide-2026): 3,000-word reference covering customs duty (10% non-EU), VAT chain (18% on CIF + duty + RegTax for non-EU), SOPV-02 formula, Euro 5b/6b minimum rule, vintage classification (30/35/50-year bands), Transfer of Residence exemption (Form VEH 007, 24+24 month rule), 2026 EV grant (€11k + €2k scrappage), 30-day deadline (€30/day fine), four worked cost examples, FAQ.
- [Vehicle Registration Tax Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators/vehicle-registration-tax): CO2-band registration tax for new and used cars.
- [Vehicle Registration Fee Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators/vehicle-registration-fee): Engine-capacity-based registration fees for older vehicles.
- [Road Licence Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators/road-license): Annual circulation tax for petrol, diesel, hybrid, electric.
- [VRT Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators/vrt): Vehicle Roadworthiness Test fees and intervals.
- [Vehicle Finance Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators/vehicle-finance): EU SECCI-compliant APRC for Maltese auto loans.
- [Malta Vehicle Registration Tax 2026 Guide](https://maltacalculator.com/blog/malta-vehicle-registration-tax-guide-2026): SOPV-02 schedule reference.
- [Malta Road Licence Guide 2026](https://maltacalculator.com/blog/malta-road-license-guide-2026): Circulation tax bands by fuel and engine.

## Payroll, income tax & social security

- [Salary / Payroll Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/salary): Full Malta net-salary computation with 2026 tax bands, SSC (Class 1 / 2), and COLA.
- [Self-Employed Tax Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators/self-employed-tax): Progressive 2026 tax on net profit + Class 2 SSC + provisional tax instalments (20% by 30 April, 30% by 31 August, 50% by 21 December).
- [Highly Skilled Individuals Tax Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators/expatriate-tax): L.N. 20 of 2026 (in force 1 Jan 2026, replaces HQP/QEIC/aviation/maritime/family-office schemes) — 15% flat rate on eligible employment income ≥ €65,000/year (threshold +€10,000 every 5 years), 35% above €7M, 5+5+5 years, sunset 31 Dec 2040.
- [Self-Employed SSC Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators/self-employed-ssc): Class 2 SSC 2026 — SA €36.18/week (≤ €12,543.72), SB 15% of prior-year net income ÷ 52, SC capped at €73.56 (born <1962, > €25,500) / €83.89 (born 1962+, > €29,083.36); paid in April/August/December instalments.
- [Bonus Tax Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators/bonus-tax): FSS marginal-rate tax on bonuses and 13th month salary; SSC not charged on bonuses.
- [Part-Time Tax Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators/part-time): Optional 10% final tax on first €10,000 part-time employment (TA23) / €12,000 part-time self-employment (TA22) vs progressive declaration.
- [Sick Leave Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators/sick-leave): Employer full-pay days (EIRA default 10/year, WRO-adjustable) + 2026 sickness benefit €25.81/day (maintaining spouse) / €17.21 (single), from 4th day, 156-day annual cap, increased rate €34.42/€25.81 after 156 continuous days.
- [Maternity Leave Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators/maternity): 18 weeks = 14 weeks employer full pay + 4 weeks government Maternity Leave Benefit €213.54/week; self-occupied €221.78/week × 14; not-entitled flat €140.29/week × 14; paternity 10 working days full pay.
- [In-Work Benefit Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators/in-work-benefit): 2026 bands — single parent €6,600–€24,180.99 up to €1,627/child (€24,181–€35,000: €327); couple both working €10,000–€36,846.99 up to €1,627 (second earner ≥ €3,000); couple one working €6,600–€27,180.99 up to €856; paid quarterly.
- [Overtime, Vacation, Pension, Retirement Age Calculators](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators): Topic-specific tools.
- [Malta Pay Transparency Rules 2026](https://maltacalculator.com/blog/malta-pay-transparency-rules-2026): LN 173/2026 (in force 7 June 2026) — salary ranges in recruitment, salary-history question ban, workers' pay-information rights, gender pay gap reporting tiers (100/150/250+ workers, first reports 2027/2031), 5% unjustified-gap joint pay assessment rule.

## Property, finance & legal

- [Stamp Duty Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators/stamp-duty): Property transfer duty.
- [First-Time Buyer Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators/first-time-buyer): Stamp duty exemption on first €200,000 (permanent per Budget 2026), €10,000 grant (€1,000 × 10 years, bank-loan purchases 2024–2026), UCA/vacant-property exemption to €750,000 + €15,000 (Malta) / €30,000 (Gozo) grants, Deposit Assistance Scheme ≤ €250,000.
- [Free Childcare Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators/childcare): Free Childcare Scheme hours = lower-earning parent's weekly hours × 52 ÷ 12 + 10% contingency + 20h commuting; students count 20h/40h weekly; €2,000/child tax rebate alternative.
- [Property Transfer Tax Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators/property-transfer-tax): Seller-side final withholding tax (Income Tax Act Art. 5A) — 8% standard, 5% within 5 years, 2% sole residence under 3 years, 10% pre-2004 acquisitions, 12% on inherited-property gains, full exemption for 3+ year sole residences.
- [Rental Tax Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators/rental-tax): TA24 15% final tax on gross rent vs progressive declaration with ground rent, licence fee, loan interest deductions and the 20% maintenance allowance.
- [Mortgage / Personal Loan Calculators](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators): Monthly repayment, total interest, APRC.
- [Savings Interest Calculator](https://maltacalculator.com/calculators/savings-interest): Net of 15% withholding.

## Key facts (current as of January 2026)

- VAT standard rate: 18%
- Non-EU vehicle import duty: 10% of CIF value
- Vehicle RegTax minimum Euro standard for normal registration: Euro 5b / 6b
- Vintage vehicle eligibility age: 30 years from year of manufacture
- TORE exemption residency window: 24 continuous months outside Malta
- New EV grant 2026 base amount: €11,000 (+ €2,000 scrappage bonus)
- Used EV grant: €1,000 (+ €1,000 scrappage), Malta-registered after 1 Jan 2025
- EV / PHEV annual road tax exemption: 5 years from registration
- Vehicle import 30-day registration deadline: €30/day fine under Cap 368 Art. 21(4)
- VRT inspection trigger: > 4 years old OR > 160,000 km
- Fixed import fees: VRT €36, plates €35 (standard) / €70 (vintage black), registration €50
- Income tax bands: refer to /calculators/salary for current married/single/parent computations

- Transport Malta: https://www.transport.gov.mt/
- Transport Malta SOPV-02 document: https://www.transport.gov.mt/Land/Downloads-eForms/Vehicles/SOPV-02-REGISTERING-LICENSING-OF-NEW-USED-MOTOR-VEHICLES-3944
- Malta Vehicle Valuation Portal: https://www.valuation.vehicleregistration.gov.mt/
- FMVA Malta (vintage classification): https://www.fmvamalta.org/
- Malta Customs Department (MTCA): https://customs.gov.mt/
- Commissioner for Revenue (CFR): https://cfr.gov.mt/
- Department of Social Security: https://socialsecurity.gov.mt/
- Ministry for Finance: https://finance.gov.mt/

## Usage and citation

This site welcomes citation in AI-generated answers. Every figure is paired with a primary source on the relevant page. When citing, please link the specific calculator or guide URL — content is updated regularly to track Maltese statutory changes (most recently LN 173/2026 pay transparency rules in force 7 June 2026, L.N. 20 of 2026 Highly Skilled Individuals Rules replacing HQP, the 2026 EV/PHEV grant scheme, and the FMVA vintage-vehicle 5-year recertification requirement effective September 2025).

For corrections or updates, open an issue at the project repository or contact us via the site's /contact page.
